title: What’s behind the Google AI shake-up
slides: What forced Google's sudden AI leadership overhaul?
Demis Hassabis now controls all AI development.
The old team had just delayed Gemini's next launch.
Expect faster model releases but less safety checks.
Ask yourself: is your app ready for weekly updates?
thread_text:
1. Who lost the race?

Google's AI chief was replaced hours after Gemini's launch slipped again. The board moved without warning.

2. One person, full control

Demis Hassabis now signs off on every model, every dataset, every release date. No committees left.

3. The price of speed

Internal reviews for safety are being cut from weeks to days. Some testers were told not to file reports.

4. Weekly surprises

Updated models will ship every seven days. That means your prompts, your evals, your guardrails could break overnight.

5. Your move

Run a regression test on your top three prompts today. If you wait for the first update, you're already behind.
